item: RI-JRN05 M1/M3-shaped/M5, measured on the live world through the public harness

declared_exclusions.reason: Engine.firstControlAt is a per-PAGE latch (RI-PLT03 TTFP) that no reset clears, so the second arm in one browser never re-fires it. An artifact of the instrument, declared rather than hidden.
declared_exclusions.stale_check_skips: paths under .const. / .budget. / .declared / .rules / .policy / .thresholds — data constants, not frame stamps
